summary_en: Wise Holdings approved acquisition of up to 750,000 shares (0.56% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 50 million yen between November 4 and December 31, 2026, to enhance per-share shareholder value and enable flexible capital management.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 2, 2026, Wise Holdings' board of directors resolved to initiate a share buyback program under the authority granted by the company's articles of incorporation under Article 459, Paragraph 1 of the Companies Act. The program authorizes acquisition of up to 750,000 ordinary shares, representing 0.56% of issued shares excluding treasury stock, for a maximum aggregate price of 50 million yen. The acquisition period runs from November 4, 2026 through December 31, 2026.

The company stated the primary objectives are to enhance per-share shareholder value and to maintain flexibility in capital allocation in response to changing business conditions. As of September 30, 2026, the company held 9,230,655 treasury shares against a base of 133,381,110 issued shares excluding treasury stock.
